verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals is an alerting product, so this story applies. However, the evidence only shows Alert Rules that decide which events become alerts, CEL backtests, alerting analytics and support-hours snoozing. Nothing documents deduplicating duplicate alerts or grouping related alerts into one page or incident. Rule-based filtering and snoozing are adjacent controls, not dedup or grouping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, duplicate and related alerts are deduplicated and grouped so one incident pages one human, not fifty
